title: Rabbi Chanan bar Pitom
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A student of Rabbi Akiva. He is mentioned in [Taanit 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.22b.13), saying in Rabbi Akiva’s name: “One does not sound the alarm for pestilence at all.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked baraita calls him Rabbi Chanan ben Pitom and identifies him as Rabbi Akiva’s student. Hyman’s heading has bar Pitom.
The opening statement permits sounding the alarm even on Shabbat. Rabbi Chanan then states Rabbi Akiva’s opposing ruling.
